sections_target.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
a monthly bases 
as indicated by M1 in the title 
block.

The technical specification of gear box, power 
rating 1800 kw input speed 90.58 RPM, output speed 1000 RPM, gear ratio 0.9058, 
oil quantity 550 L

The first draft was initiated, tested and approved by Eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed, 
General Manager of

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
Safety precautions

A work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 the required warning signs surrounding the work area.

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the crane and switch off the power supply
